sources.entry: Vienna - Vienna is a RSS/Atom newsreader for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Vienna is an RSS, Atom and JSON Feed newsreader for macOS with an Apple Mail-style interface.
summary.what_it_does: Vienna lets you subscribe to feeds directly from the websites you want to track, or sync with a cloud server that supports the Open Reader API (an adaptation of the Google Reader API). The README says it has been tested with BazQux.com, FreshRSS.org, FeedHQ.org, InoReader.com and TheOldReader.com. The interface is modeled on Apple Mail: you scan feed summaries quickly, then open individual articles in a simplified browser view. Article display is customizable through HTML/CSS styles, and menus and toolbars can be extended with XML-based .plist plugins. Installation is via GitHub Releases, SourceForge, or Homebrew Cask.
use_cases: read RSS feeds on a Mac
sync feeds with FreshRSS or Inoreader
scan feed summaries and read articles
add custom menu or toolbar actions
stack: Objective-C/Cocoa (inferred from README references to Cocoa and plugin .plist files)
notable: Open Reader API sync with self-hosted and cloud services such as FreshRSS and Inoreader
Apple Mail-style layout with summary list and article view
Customizable article styles using HTML templates and CSS
XML .plist-based plugins that need no Cocoa knowledge
caveats: Vienna 3.11.x requires macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later; older Vienna versions support older macOS releases
The README says the project has strict rules on LLM/'AI' usage, which may limit outside contributions
Cloud sync is only tested with the listed services; other Open Reader API servers are not guaranteed
